decisions.reason: After surviving its first two years, this close-to-core sensor module likely meets or is near aspiration and a growing firm with slack will usually retain it as part of the modular platform.
Its strong fit with the firm's industrial I/O architecture and earlier dedicated presentation suggest satisfactory performance relative to aspiration, so management would keep it.
As a low-risk extension that complements existing control hardware, it likely remains acceptable versus aspiration and does not justify reallocating resources away from it yet.
This newer module is still in the learning period, and with organizational slack and broad platform synergies the firm would keep it while demand information accumulates.
Remote access for wallboxes fits the firm's stated expansion into charging and energy management, so despite some service-related uncertainty it is strategically important enough to retain.
